'''Doruns''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Its members had twin [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] instead of arms, and [[Eye/Legends|eyestalks]] that could be moved independently of each other.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
